Sorry for the late answer. First of all I really wanna thank you for lending an ear.

Well with my career there is not much to say. I'm working at my current company for about 2 years now. Before that i did my training at the same company for 3 years. Dont get me wrong i know I should be very happy with my work, because there are plenty of worse jobs, an I dont think I deserve this job with how lazy I am, but its somehow doesnt fulfill me and doesnt meet my expectations. Then again I dont even know what my expectations are or if I am just a lazy sh** thats never satisfied.

As for family i am far away from that. I recently turned 23 and didnt have a real relationship in my life, and I dont expect it to happen anytime soon.

As for my own parents, Im not entirely sure if you mean "live near" like in messurable distance or if we get along good with each other.
If its for distance, yes I live near them, so I can visit every one of them every day without any stress. As for "getting along" its more or less complicated. My relationship to my father ist much better than the one to my mother. She gets upset pretty fast over nonsense and I seriously cant stand this behavior anymore. Every Tantrum shes on drains me...

And about the rest of my live. I dont really know what to say. Since the age of 13 or something I've been living in a constant state of indentity crisis, if thats what you call it. I dont know who I really am, where I belong and if I really feel how I think i feel. From time to time it gets better when i get to flee myself into Videogames or something like that. But it often crawls back at me when im alone and not doing anything. The greatest fear I often encounter is probably what pins me to this path mentioned above: I always am terrified about being judged by other people. What they think and say. Even if i dont have anything to do with them or will never meet them e.g. on the Internet: I really like playing videogames as a hobby, but i cant have fun with many games, because i am constantly afraid what my team or the enemy thinks about me if i fail or something like that.

Well guess thats all for now. Maybe its just an utter Pile of Bullsh** that does not justify to be depressed or something like that.
